response.overview: On a windy afternoon, three kids skipped their graduation ceremony and ran into a sloping and lush hillside to fly a kite, which was left by their other friend that had just moved away. On the hill, a strange gale swayed their kite and accidently stuck it into the top of the abandoned water tower standing alone on the meadow. The kids decided to risk climbing up the shabby ladder, and some magical and mysterious things happened to them on the top that made them change. Eventually, the kids could only witness the kite flying away but couldn’t stop it. However, on the top of the tower, they saw the scenery of the town they had never seen before.
response.title: The Windy Day
